name: EDCI 5042
title: Diversity, Culture, and Music Education
description: This discussion-oriented seminar draws upon areas of diversity, equity, and access in music education. Focuses on curricula materials, including repertoire that is culturally responsive, represents different people’s and identities, and musical practices.
requirement_description: Open to students enrolled in the M.A. in Curriculum and Instruction, Music Education concentration, or with instructor approval; IBM students may take this course under special circumstances with advisor approval.
